title: Tofino Sea Kayaking
specs: Explore stunning historical islands of Tofino's harbour
Paddle through old-growth forest and giant cedars on Meares Island
Experience diverse ecosystems including eel grass mudflats and inter-tidal zones
Use of expedition fiberglass sea kayaks designed locally
Kayak cockpit fits up to approx. 6.4' (195cm) height and 46" (117cm) waist size
Pregnant women allowed only up to 15 weeks (first trimester)
Inform staff of injuries or medical conditions affecting kayaking or walking on uneven terrain
Physical stamina required for kayaking in exposed natural environment with winds, currents, rain, and rugged terrain
No smoking, vaping, or influence of drugs/alcohol allowed on tours
Tour ratios typically 1 guide to 6 participants; max 2 guides to 12 people

blurb: Guests paddle guided sea kayak tours exploring islands, old-growth forests, and coastal ecosystems around Tofino and Clayoquot Sound. Tours include instruction, stops to explore nature, and opportunities to learn about local ecology and cultural history. Private and family tours are available, with options for customized experiences.
